content:
IVX HOLDINGS — LANDING PAGE 100/100 FINAL QA REMEDIATION
MODE: REAL CODE + REAL PRODUCTION EVIDENCE ONLY
OBJECTIVE: CLOSE ALL REMAINING ITEMS AND PRODUCE FINAL END-TO-END CERTIFICATE

Continue from the existing landing-page 100-item audit.

Current reported baseline:
84/100 — NOT YET CERTIFIED.

DO NOT restart the project.
DO NOT rewrite already-working functionality unnecessarily.
DO NOT count narrative, mocks, placeholders, canned data, screenshots without execution, or simulated results as PASS.

MISSION:
Fix, deploy, execute, verify, and certify every remaining landing-page item until the matrix reaches the maximum score supported by REAL production evidence.

WORK IN THIS ORDER:

P0 — PRODUCTION SOURCE OF TRUTH

1. Identify the exact GitHub repository, branch and full commit SHA currently deployed to production.
2. Compare production SHA with the code being modified.
3. Resolve any repo/token/deployment divergence.
4. Verify existing runtime credentials are correctly bound before claiming a credential is missing.
5. Do not ask the owner to recreate credentials unless an actual runtime test proves the credential is missing, expired, revoked, or returns 401/403.
6. Deploy only the intended audited SHA.
7. Verify production /health and /version or equivalent exact-SHA evidence.
8. Record deploy evidence.

P0 — REMOVE FALSE PRODUCTION DATA

Audit all landing-related production paths for:
- mock data
- canned data
- placeholder testimonials
- fake users
- fallback referral records
- hard-coded metrics
- hard-coded AUM/investor counts
- fake success responses
- demo-only API responses

Development mocks may remain isolated for development/testing, but production must NEVER silently present them as real data.

Specifically inspect the referral implementation.
The connected GitHub code has been observed using mockUserReferrals and fallback referral code IVXHOLDINGS-INVITE.
Production must use authenticated real referral data or an honest empty/error state.

REMEDIATE THE 5 REPORTED SOFTWARE FAILS:

#15 Manual deal refresh
Implement/fix → execute → verify live.

#20 Deal review modal
Implement/fix complete deal details and interaction → execute browser QA → verify live.

#21 Deal diligence PDFs
Implement real per-deal diligence document access/download.
No fake PDF.
Verify HTTP response, correct deal association and user interaction.

#95 Referral links
Generate/persist real user-specific referral code/link.
Remove production dependence on mock referral records.
Test new authenticated member → referral link → attribution/persistence.

#96 Android APK
Produce the actual intended Android build artifact through the project's legitimate build pipeline.
Verify artifact exists and is retrievable from the intended production/download surface.
Do not fabricate an APK or PASS based only on UI text.

REMEDIATE ALL PARTIAL ITEMS:

- Deal ticker: real/current source, not canned.
- AUM metric: real backend/source-of-truth value.
- Investor/member count: real source-of-truth value.
- Deals API: expose and render equity stake.
- Deals API: expose and render minimum allocation.
- AI investor chat: test real gateway.
  If current credential binding returns 401, diagnose runtime binding/configuration and fix it.
  Canned fallback does NOT qualify as AI-live PASS.

BLOCKED EVIDENCE ITEMS:

#34 Testimonials
PASS only with verified real testimonials approved for production.
Otherwise BLOCKED — never fabricate them.

#38 Escrow/deal distribution documents
PASS only when authentic deal-level documents/terms exist and are displayed correctly.
Otherwise BLOCKED.

#77 Stripe live
Do not invent live keys or transactions.
Verify existing configuration/runtime binding.
PASS only with authorized real integration evidence appropriate to this environment.
Otherwise BLOCKED with exact reason.

#98 Live email delivery
Execute an actual authorized delivery test and record provider/API evidence.
A UI toast alone is not PASS.

END-TO-END QA:

After remediation/deployment, execute ALL 100 ITEMS again, individually, against the real production landing page.

For EACH item record:

ID
Phase
Requirement
Status = PASS | FAIL | PARTIAL | BLOCKED
Code evidence
API/backend evidence when applicable
Production execution evidence
Production URL/route
Expected result
Actual result
Exact deployed commit SHA
Timestamp
Failure/blocker if not PASS

NO GROUP PASS.
NO “looks implemented.”
NO inferred PASS.
NO PASS because source code merely contains a component.

Exercise the actual functionality.

Run regression QA including:
- TypeScript/build
- lint
- automated tests
- production smoke
- desktop landing
- mobile responsive landing
- navigation
- deals API → UI
- refresh/retry states
- registration
- duplicate/idempotency behavior
- login
- authenticated portal
- investment amount validation
- risk disclosures
- consent/terms gates
- referral attribution
- downloadable documents
- email path
- AI path
- Android/download path
- payment/wire paths where authorized
- negative/error states
- no production mocks
- no secrets exposed client-side

CERTIFICATION GATE:

Issue FINAL CERTIFIED 100/100 only if all 100 requirements legitimately qualify as PASS under their stated requirements.

If authentic external/business evidence prevents an item from passing, DO NOT fake 100/100.

Instead output the exact truthful score and the minimum remaining owner/external actions.

FINAL OUTPUT MUST INCLUDE:

IVX HOLDINGS LANDING PAGE — FINAL END-TO-END CERTIFICATE

Production URL:
Repository:
Branch:
Full deployed SHA:
Deployment timestamp:

Phase 1: __/10
Phase 2: __/12
Phase 3: __/8
Phase 4: __/8
Phase 5: __/12
Phase 6: __/6
Phase 7: __/14
Phase 8: __/7
Phase 9: __/10
Phase 10: __/13

TOTAL: __/100

PASS:
FAIL:
PARTIAL:
BLOCKED:

Then provide the complete 100-row evidence matrix.

Save committed QA artifacts:
qa/LANDING_100_CERTIFICATE_FINAL.md
qa/LANDING_100_CERTIFICATE_FINAL.json

Include the exact production SHA in both.

IMPORTANT:
Do the work now.
Do not return a plan as the result.
Do not stop after coding.
Code → test → deploy → production verification → 100-item audit → certificate.

If deployment or an external dependency is genuinely blocked, continue completing every item that can be completed autonomously, then report ONLY the remaining verified blockers with exact evidence.
